prompt: High-fidelity desktop web app UI composition for Llanqui, a Spanish employment platform, candidate view. Preserve this precise visual identity: white top navigation bar, Inter typography, primary blue #2838D3, lime #B9EF4A, app background #F6F7FB, white operational cards with 14-16px radius and thin cool-gray borders. Create an operate-mode dashboard with compact header, a clear next-action area, a real jobs list, profile progress, and no social feed. Layout must be a practical responsive SaaS interface, not a poster. Use only Spanish labels that describe actual employment tasks. No brand logos copied, no fake analytics, no glassmorphism, no gradients as decoration, no emojis.
